question: 在2014年底当时已上市A股中，中期相对强弱能否帮助月度选择，并超越最近一个月涨幅及波动/成交活跃程度这些简单信息？
mechanism_hypothesis: 信息可能逐步被理解和反映，中期较强股票随后仍较强；最近短期波动可能暂时反转。关联不能单独证明信息反应缓慢。
original_strategy_relation: 独立研究用途；不修改原LEI规则，不与日线/小时/回调任务重叠；股票结果不替代ETF可用性

definition.q: 本股票日期升序、实际交易且正数的BaoStock前复权收盘价；有效报价位移，非252共同交易日；停牌天无新有效报价
definition.direction: 高分排前，按code字典顺序打破精确同分
definition.status: reuse registered numeric definition; provider economic-price proxy qualification separately assessed

universe.source: BaoStock historical day all_stock and stock_basic identity cross-check; complete exchange-level verification not yet assumed
universe.type: 沪深A股，sh60/sz00/sz30；排除指数B股；不按今天存续状态筛选
universe.selection: 先形成完整历史名单，再按sha256("lowfreq-20141231-v1|"+code)升序取前600；名单少于600则全部但不得宣称满足600
universe.monthly_eligibility: 月末实际交易、有完整253条有效报价、三个因子均有限、历史当日isST=0；只按观察日前资料判资格；保留全600的每月不合格原因
universe.actual_years: 收益评价2015-01至2025-12，共132月；预热不算评价年限

timing.decision: 每月最后交易日收盘后；评价月为之后第一个月
timing.exit: 下一次月末决策后的次交易日收盘
timing.claim: 延后一天的价格变化/选择价值，不声称限价、停牌和真实账户可成交

top_selection: ceil(N*0.2), same universe, equal target weights. quintiles rank partition deterministic
increment: 每月按vol60排序分3组，每个波动组按amount20再分3组；每组中期动量最高ceil(n/5)与本组全体对照，再按该组n/N汇总；背景控制只有波动与成交额，行业尚未排除

missing_outcomes.unknown_entry_or_exit: retain original target weight; report unknown weight and counts, observed weighted contribution separately; no backfill chosen names
missing_outcomes.scenario_warning: 仅两种明确情景，并非对合并/退出最终价值的真实上下界；缺失不得默认为0
missing_outcomes.source_suspension_close: 来源停牌报价允许作为账面估值但标记不可交易；不自动填漏报价；退出后缺报未知

uncertainty.interpretation: 保留相邻月份联系的历史不确定范围，不代表新资料确认

secondary_value_metrics: monthly std, worst month, mean worst10% months
hypothetical monthly marked-price cumulative path and peak-to-trough decline, explicitly non-investable estimate
target-list half-L1 replacement turnover, not actual drifted trading turnover
maximum sustainable per-target-replacement cost sensitivity, not real fee quote
robustness: per-stock excess contribution and remove largest5 contributors post-hoc diagnostic without reranking
workflow_boundary: native continuous/binary prediction workflow does not support same-day selection and source qfq economic proxy; dedicated research-tool module with preflight/synthetic/freeze/source-hash/ledger/independent reconciliation; do not forge native workflow receipt
evidence_stage: retrospective historical exploratory validation; old momentum family exposed, not untouched confirmation
